title: New MSFS 2020 Activities just released! Unique flights, historic missions & airline schedules
description:
This week’s Marketplace Update brings a fresh batch of must‑have activities to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 on PC, including brand‑new airline missions, historic scenarios, and real‑world schedules that simmers will love.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR Missions – A320 Wizz Air (Airline‑themed mission pack)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain – Aer Lingus (Airliner challenges & missions)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: History by Air – Battle of the Bulge (WWII historic scenario)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Above the Sky Master Collection – 05 (Mission bundle)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Advanced Landings Master Collection – 04 (Landing challenges pack)
🗺️ Koschi: E 40 – The longest European road (Long‑form exploration mission)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 1 (Scenic exploration activity)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 2 (Scenic exploration activity)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 3 (Scenic exploration activity)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 4 (Scenic exploration activity)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 5 (Scenic exploration activity)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airline Schedules – AAR [Winter 2025] (Real‑world airline ops)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airline Schedules – AZU [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA Systems: Airline Schedules – JBU [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA Systems: Airline Schedules – KQA [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA Systems: Airline Schedules – THY [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA Systems: Airport Schedules – EDDM [Winter 2025] (Munich)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airport Schedules – HECA [Winter 2025] (Cairo)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airport Schedules – KSEA [Winter 2025] (Seattle)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airport Schedules – SBGL [Winter 2025] (Rio de Janeiro)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airport Schedules – VTBS [Winter 2025] (Bangkok)

If you enjoy these updates, don’t forget to hit that like button, subscribe for more MSFS content, and drop a comment telling me which new activity you’re checking out first!

Thanks for watching and supporting the channel — it really helps the community grow.

✈️ See you in the skies!
